metadata.title: Regularity of Weak Solutions near Singular Minimizing Cones for the One-Phase Free Boundary Problem
metadata.abstract: Alt and Caffarelli proved an Allard-type $\epsilon$-regularity theorem near the flat one-homogeneous minimizer of the one-phase free boundary problem. A natural follow-up question is whether an analogous regularity result holds near singular minimizing cones. In this paper, we prove such an $\epsilon$-regularity theorem near a strongly integrable one-phase minimizing cone with an isolated singularity. More precisely, we show that, after a suitable translation and rotation, the free boundary of any non-degenerate weak solution sufficiently close to the cone is graphical over the free boundary of a leaf of the De Silva--Jerison--Shahgholian foliation. This result is analogous to recent $\epsilon$-regularity theorems in minimal surface theory by Edelen and by Edelen--Spolaor; our proof adapts the strategy of Edelen to the one-phase setting.

analysis.topic: 几何分析、几何 PDE 与几何流
analysis.workSummary: 对强可积且仅有孤立奇异性的1次齐次一相极小锥，建立相近非退化弱解的ε正则性。
analysis.breakthrough: 当B₂中的L²偏差足够小时，在小平移、小旋转及叶参数调整后，自由边界局部成为DSJS叶的图，并有按到奇点距离缩放的C²小量控制。证明补充图形小扰动推出函数L²相近，再用全局弱解刚性排除反例极限。
analysis.limitations: 背景锥需强可积、极小且仅有原点奇异；弱解需规定的三参数非退化条件。叶参数非零时模型叶光滑，结论不要求相近解仍有原点奇异。补读主结果与路线，未独立核验引用的强可积性和全局刚性定理。
